title: Pumpkin Muffins with Cream Cheese Frosting
summary: Pumpkin Muffins with Cream Cheese Frosting are a delectable and easy to make fall treat! Use up the cans of pumpkin purée in your pantry and make these with the whole family!
steps: Place the first 5 ingredients in a bowl and whisk to combine.
In a separate bowl whisk the remaining ingredients.
Add the dry ingredients into the wet and whisk until just combined.
Pour into greased muffins cups 3/4 full.
Bake for 20 minutes. Allow to cool before frosting.
Combine all ingredients and beat for 1-2 minutes, until fluffy. Frost cupcakes and serve!
